products.name: SimpleScreen CRC
products.data_scope: Patient blood sample data, multiomics biomarkers, clinical history; handles Protected Health Information (PHI)
products.notes: Blood-based colorectal cancer screening test; FDA PMA submitted August 2025, expected approval mid-2026. Clinical validation: 85% CRC sensitivity, 22% APL sensitivity at 90% specificity. Partner: Exact Sciences (Abbott) for commercialization.

products.name: PREEMPT CRC Study
products.data_scope: 40,000+ trial participants; full clinical and genomic data collection for validation and research
products.notes: Largest prospective colorectal cancer screening study; generates clinical evidence for SimpleScreen platform validation and FDA submissions.

products.name: PROACT LUNG Study
products.data_scope: Up to 20,000 geographically and demographically representative participants; lung cancer screening data
products.notes: Ongoing lung cancer early detection study; recruitment and validation phase.

compare.pricing_model: Not disclosed publicly; clinical laboratory service model (likely test-per-order with insurance/patient reimbursement)

Primary products are FDA-regulated medical devices (pending approval) and clinical studies, not software tools for purchase. Question whether this vendor is appropriate for AIFoxx's AI tools directory.
